name: openviking-memory
description: Long-term semantic memory for Claude Code, powered by OpenViking. Recall on UserPromptSubmit, incremental add_message on Stop (per turn), commit on SessionEnd and PreCompact, with an idle/ended sweep on SessionStart. Includes a local stdio MCP proxy that reads OpenViking credentials from env/ovcli.conf.

url.title: OpenViking server URL
url.description: API root of your OpenViking server, for example https://openviking.example.com. Leave empty to use ~/.openviking/ovcli.conf or the OPENVIKING_* environment variables.

api_key.title: OpenViking API key
api_key.description: A user or admin key for that server, not the root key. Leave empty to use ~/.openviking/ovcli.conf or OPENVIKING_API_KEY.

account.title: Account (trusted-mode servers only)
account.description: Sent as the account identity header. Leave empty when the server authenticates by API key.

user.title: User (trusted-mode servers only)
user.description: Sent as the user identity header. Leave empty when the server authenticates by API key.
